# Kaze

A calm, quick browser for macOS with an agent that works in your tabs.

This repository holds Kaze's homepage, [kaze.build](https://kaze.build). The site is plain
static files in [`Website/`](Website) — HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript, no build step.
Open `Website/index.html` to view it locally.

It is served by Cloudflare as static assets (`wrangler.jsonc`): `npx wrangler deploy` publishes
`Website/` to kaze.build and www.kaze.build.
